newsitem.title: USA: U.S. military pages off Internet after hack attempt.
newsitem.headline: U.S. military pages off Internet after hack attempt.

text.p: Most Defence Department information was pulled off the Internet world-wide computer network on Monday after a hacker break-in attempt damaged an Air Force page.
The Air Force said most of the information was expected to be back on the network by late Monday.

The Defence Department has more than 80 World Wide Web sites on the public Internet including a Gulf War Illness site, information about each of the military services, news releases and military contract announcements.

The Air Force said most of the web sites were taken off the Internet after a hacking attempt on Sunday destroyed its home page, the page that guides computer users to Air Force information available on the computer network.
It said federal authorities were investigating.
